about: The walls' catalogue (custom geometry plan, M4): every wall-shaped fracturing mesh of the install (the 344 of research/evidence/wall-look-audit-2026-11-18.json) as a look, measured by tools/bake/wall_measure.py at the placing to copy (map, actor: at scale 1 where the mesh has one) and given its twin check (the wall made at its donor's length and measured again: 'ok', or what differs).
